verdict.rationale: Maritime documents a REST API at /docs/api, but nothing in the evidence shows an interactive reference such as a try-it console, an API explorer or runnable examples. Probes for an OpenAPI or Swagger spec at all candidate paths returned 404. A static API docs page is adjacent to the story and does not deliver an interactive reference with runnable examples.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
